_about: WHEN THE ORIGINAL UNLOCKS AN ACHIEVEMENT, how it keeps the unlocked set, and the two cards and the
popup that show it. Read by sim/Achievements.hpp and sim/Notificator.hpp; planning step 143.
NUMBERS AND NAMES ONLY. Each achievement's title, description, icon and points are Asantee-authored and
live in Enhanced's gitignored out/data/achievements.json (tools/asbc/achievements.py), read at run time
beside chapters.json. This file names an achievement by its id alone, and says what unlocks it.
Every rule is DECODED from Enhanced's out/parity/asbc/all_functions.txt (md5
48fe65ce8baea16b94ed84d8d7be84b0), read by the rules of out/parity/visuals/briefs/00_order.md 8.0:
arguments are pushed last-first, and `CMPIu vX, vN` / `SetV4 vX, vN` carry the CONSTANT N, whatever
name the listing puts beside vN. Instruction numbers (#) are the function's own.
WHERE THE ORIGINAL UNLOCKS, all through AchievementManager::unlock(id, notify, delay) (247231..248007):
- the door's frame: GameStateController::writeScore builds LevelFinishedLayer, whose constructor
(271777..273843) calls registerMedalAchievements(g_currentWorld, true) (#499-502) - after setScore
has saved the medal - and then checkForLevelAchievements(g_currentWorld, currentLevel, score,
numPortals, GameStateController::getGameTime(), true) (#504-516): `completion` and `level` below;
- chapter select, on every visit: WorldSelector::WorldSelector (167326..168612) #265-291,
registerMedalAchievements(t, true) for every chapter t;
- the main menu, on every visit: PortalMainMenu::preLoop #395-396 calls
checkPreviouslyUnlockAchievements (202712..202943): for every world registerMedalAchievements(t,
false) and for every level checkForLevelAchievements(t, l, getScore(t, l), 99999, 0, false) - with the
state not 'Game', which only the medal and completion rules pass;
- in play: `key` and `help_block` below.
Not built: AchievementManager::mergeOtherAchievementFiles (246105..246631), which merges another
version's file found under GetExternalStoragePath and findOtherVersionPath (there is none on this
platform), and unlock #58-72's ForwardCommand('flurry ACHIEVEMENT_UNLOCKED_ID_' + id), analytics.

THE PORT keeps the same two values under the same names in its own JSON, achievements.json in the
directory scores.json is in (sim/Scores.hpp says why not the original's enml). A save from before
this step has no such file: it opens empty, and the main menu's pass fills it from the medals, as
the original's does on every visit.

A RULE IS ALL OF ITS TERMS:
medal_at_least N   score >= N (CMPIu score, vN with JS past, or TNS)
medal_above N      score > N (JNP past, or TP)
portals_at_most N  numPortals <= N (JP past, or JNP into, or TNP)
portals_exactly N  numPortals == N (JNZ past, or JZ into)
game               the current state is 'Game' (string::opEquals, then JLowZ past)
time_at_most_ms N  gameTime <= N (JNP into): GameStateController.m_gameTime, which update
(123254..123683 #3-10) adds g_timeManager's frame time to before checkGameEnd

WHAT THE PORT READS FOR A RULE'S ENTITIES, at the door's tick (MagicPortalsLayer::achievementsAtDoor):
count and exists ask every entity the level placed by its metadata/entity_name - still in the world,
a shot anti-portal agent not, a burned crate or broken stone not (its body destroyed) - and what was
added since: a launcher's thrown stones and the minions the markers spawned, by the entity each adds.
A torch is the exception: lighting one deletes it (ETHCallback_light_off #1-35, #105-114) where the
port keeps the node and marks it lit, and the fire signal that puts one back out adds a FRESH
`signal_torch` (ETHCallback_fire_signal; torch.json), whatever the first was named - so
SeekEntity('light_off.ent') finds an unlit torch placed under that name or one a signal put out.
spottedCount reads every live minion.ent's enemySpotCount, which only sight raises. The port's sight is built
since planning step 158 (G1a, minions.json `sight`) and counts each sighting in Minions::State::SpotCount(),
which MagicPortalsLayer::SpottedCount() returns since planning step 159 (G1b): a knight that has seen the
player or a portal spoils the seven stealth achievements (24, 26, 28, 32, 42, 66, 76) while it stands, and one that
is destroyed after it did no longer counts, as GetEntityArray('minion.ent') no longer holds it.

draw: currentScale = scale(that) units a sprite pixel; the font at fontScale x currentScale; iconSize x
currentScale, and when there is an icon the text box is widened by half its width (textPitch); the

card's middle (screen point less (0, origin.y x height x 0.5)) + textOffset x scale + (textPitch, 0);
the icon at V2_HALF, the card's middle less (textBoxWidth / 2, 0) + textOffset x scale.
